sourceCoverage.limitations: Interior root/spine/pelvis/chest points are source-local control frames inside the shell, not seen bones. Far limb emergence under the shell is partly occluded; far hip/shoulder landmarks are interpretations under the shell rim. Each ankle part is the whole visible foot block with the ankle landmark in its interior (the C266 tortoise a02/a03 lesson). a01 static RED: melee:claw folded 23 triangles where root-owned plastron vertices abut the fore-near knee/ankle seam (fold-diag); a02 moves the fore-near knee and ankle pivots below the plastron edge so the plastron-adjacent upper leg is one emergence part. a03 (variant 1 of 2 after a02 static RED: claw folds inside the fore-near foot block): hippo convention, each fore-near pivot 17-22px inside its own part.
